requirements.text: Generate gate passes directly from Tally invoice data with one click, auto-populating vehicle number and eliminating manual re-typing.
Require every departing truck to have a valid invoice issued prior to gate departure.
Include the e-way bill number on the gate pass for any consignment exceeding Rs 1,00,000.
Allow night gate dispatches to leave using hand-written chits upon phone authorization when the office is closed, capturing date, lorry number, party, in time, out time, and chit number.
Support night duty guard handovers where Montu logs night dispatches and Bablu verifies them the next morning.
Provide offline capability in the gate application to operate without a continuous internet connection or reliable mobile signal.
Provide a reconciliation module to match handwritten night dispatches with invoices created on subsequent days.

conflicts.about: Dev asserts that every truck leaves with an invoice before departure, whereas the gate register records 17 night dispatches (13.8%) leaving on handwritten chits without invoices.
conflicts.resolution: Allow gate pass system to record emergency night dispatches via chits while creating an automated reconciliation queue to match them with Tally invoices generated the next day.

conflicts.about: Dev states that no truck ever leaves the gate without an invoice, while Bablu explains that night dispatches leave on handwritten chits when the office is shut and invoices are made the next morning.
conflicts.resolution: Implement a dual-mode entry process supporting immediate invoice-backed passes during daytime and chit-based entry for authorized night dispatches.

constraints: The gate cabin has no wired internet line and is located 200 metres from the office, with cellular phone signal dropping completely near the weighbridge.
Total sanctioned project budget is strictly capped at Rs 75,000 all-inclusive, including hardware.
Gate register records provided for analysis were manually copied by hand and cover only a single month (2026-10-01 to 2026-10-31).
The physical gate register lacks columns for consignment value, weight, and e-way bill numbers, preventing automated rule verification directly from register data.
register_findings: 123 movements logged 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-31: 106 on invoices, 17 on handwritten chits (13.8%).
Invoice arrivals start between 09:04 and 17:53; departures end by 19:08 (average dwell 50 min). Chit arrivals start between 20:25 and 23:57; departures end by 23:59 (average dwell 24 min).
All 17 chit movements start at or after 20:00: 11 by Montu, 6 by Bablu.
No row falls on a Sunday: all 4 Sundays in the period are empty, and 0 weekdays are also dark.
Invoice GP/26-27/2386 appears 2 times: row 5 on 2026-10-01 (invoice); row 59 on 2026-10-15 (chit).
1 of 17 chit rows carry an invoice number; the rest have none to link to.
123 of 123 vehicle numbers appear only once; not one vehicle returns twice in 123 movements.
The register has no value, weight, or e-way bill columns, so invoice-value rules cannot be checked from this data.
Trucks per active day: min 3, max 6, mean 4.6 over 27 active days.
Source note: Ghosh Polymers gate register, 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-31, copied from the red register by hand.
Requirements, conflicts and constraints were extracted from 52 interview quotes in one LLM call (live gemini-3.5-flash); every register number above was computed by code.
plan: Build a standalone offline-first gate entry application capable of capturing vehicle movement details without continuous internet access.
Implement entry forms for date, vehicle number, party name, arrival/departure timestamps, chit numbers, and e-way bill details.
Add e-way bill recording and validation flags without hard-blocking dispatches based on consignment value limits.
Develop a reconciliation module for logging handwritten night chits and flagging unmatched entries for next-day review.
Deploy prototype software to gate-suitable hardware within the sanctioned Rs 75,000 budget constraint.
Prepare Tally data import interfaces to be enabled once Dev explicitly authorizes sales data exports from accounts.
